content: जीव {%a.%} [जीव्-कर्तरि क] Living, existing; जीवपुत्रे निवर्तस्व <ls>Rām. 4. 19. 11</ls>; असच्च सज्जीवमजीवमन्यत् <ls>Bhāg. 5. 10. 12</ls>. .{@-वः@} .²1 The principle of life, the vital breath, life, soul; गतजीव, जीवत्याग, जीवाशा <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The individual or personal soul enshrined in the human body and imparting to it life, motion and sensation (called जीवात्मन् as opposed to परमात्मन् the Supreme Soul); <ls>Y. 3. 131</ls>; <ls>Ms. 12. 22-23</ls>; सम्पद्यते गुणैर्मुक्तो जीवो जीवं विहाय माम् . जीवो जीवविनिर्मुक्तो गुणैश्चाशयसंभवैः .. <ls>Bhāg. 11. 25. 36</ls>. (here जीव = लिङ्गशरीर). .²3 Life, existence. .²4 A creature, living being. .²5 Livelihood, profession. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Karṇa. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Maruts. .²8 The constellation पुष्य. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of Bṛhaspati. .²10 The third lustrum in the cycle of Jupiter. .²11 Association of cause and effect. .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
